document: Instructions for Form PENS.E/6-A - Election to Defer Payment (less than 5 years of contributory service)

chunks.heading: Purpose of form PENS.E/6-A
chunks.text: A participant with less than 5 years of contributory service becomes entitled, upon separation, only to a withdrawal settlement under article 31(b)(i). Form PENS.E/6-A elects to defer payment of that withdrawal settlement for up to 36 months after separation, under article 32. To elect to receive payment instead, form PENS.E/6-B should be used.

chunks.heading: Interest during the deferment period
chunks.text: No interest accrues on the withdrawal settlement during the period of deferment.

chunks.heading: Requesting payment during the deferment period
chunks.text: The participant may request payment of the benefit at any time during the 36-month period by submitting payment instructions on form PENS.E/6-B.

chunks.heading: Effect of resuming participation during deferment
chunks.text: If the participant resumes participation in the Fund within the 36-month deferment period before the benefit is paid, participation is deemed continuous and no payment is made until the participant separates from service again. The period between separation and re-entry is considered a break in service and cannot be made pensionable.

chunks.heading: What happens if participation is not resumed within 36 months
chunks.text: If the participant does not resume participation within the 36-month deferment period, they must submit payment instructions (form PENS.E/6-B) to the Fund by the end of that period.

chunks.heading: Forfeiture of the right to a withdrawal settlement
chunks.text: Under article 46, the right to a withdrawal settlement is forfeited if, for two years after payment becomes due, the beneficiary fails to submit payment instructions or fails/refuses to accept payment.

chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.E/6-A
chunks.text: Section 1 - Participant information; Section 2 - Emergency contact (for UNJSPF's use only when normal channels of contact fail); Section 3 - Acknowledgement and signature.

chunks.heading: How to submit form PENS.E/6-A
chunks.text: The dated and hand-signed form must be returned to the secretary of the Staff Pension Committee or directly to UNJSPF for UN family staff members, via MSS Document Upload or mailed to UNJSPF's New York or Geneva offices.
